warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C2' — footing mark + the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20x0.20, 6-DB12 on S-05). C2 is recorded here once (12 points); the floor-level columns are C1 on the structure view.
F2 (two-pile cap, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-04) is the single cap at C2, drawn with its 0.90 side along x. All other 11 points are F1 (single pile).
